decisions.text: The maintenance slice kept Cabal cleanup, lint discovery, and the classified component carrier together because they share one inventory. Formatting-only source changes remained separately reviewable. The lint negative control exercised the existing command. The carrier inventories all declarations and compiles the supported set without running the retained commands.

coverage-handoff.text: The reviewed source revision measured seventy discovered Haskell files in twenty-two directories, sixty-eight files in Fourmolu after two preserved verifier exclusions, and fifty-seven files in nine HLint directories. Thirteen other files remain outside HLint. Older hint counts are historical snapshots. Final epic issue 278 owns full code coverage, including code beyond offchain Haskell. The carrier's ten included members built and passed required CI, while nine retained commands remain unverified with distinct repair issues. Historic direct build failures do not become current-head results.

a-011-release-instruction-correction.text: The operator directed a forward correction of current release and consumer instructions. The assembled archive checker and four checksum-valid negative controls now enforce the available versus retained command promise. Existing published archives and historic failed receipts remain unchanged. At the reviewed source revision, the archive gate passed and exact-head CI supplied the release-check witness that the local host could not. This documentation correction must receive a fresh exact-head audit, gate and CI before epic acceptance.
